answer: Because the timing is logged against the forge challenge, the oasis audit can replay the kernel history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 136 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The per-identity price is 120 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
